name: Vanguard fighter (the player's)
note: The player's fighter starts on the GTF Ulysses' defence and parts (as its flight numbers do). Carries every weapon so the range can try them all; the loadout piece will pick two guns and two missile types.

shield.unit: hp (FS2 total over four quadrants; the bubble gets shieldBubbleScale of it)

geometry.about: One box about the hull (wings included); the shield bubble is derived from it like the juice's.

arms.hardpointsWhy: USER REQUEST (2026-10-24 playtest: the lasers should come from the bottom left and bottom right of the main view, so you see a fuller view of them as they shoot). The cockpit eye is at (0, 0.4, 1.5) with a 55 degree vertical view (about 86 horizontal at 16:9); these muzzles sit 3.1 to 3.4 m ahead of the eye, 2.0 m out and 1.25 m below it: the corners of the picture, about 70% of the way out to the side edge and 78% of the way down to the bottom (screen NDC about +-0.70, -0.78), the heavy gun stays where it was, already low in the middle (about 0, -0.88). The guns still converge on the nose axis at the target range (or gunConvergenceRange), so shots land where the lead pip says.

partsSource: hpPercent: a share of the hull, FS2's way (ships.tbl GTF Ulysses $Subsystem: engines 35, weapons 20, sensors 10); two engine pods split the engines' share, each gun mount takes the weapons' share
